//: Feature 32, one of the shaman's four teach lines. Offered once (hw_stat_goat_spirit_bound == 1; hw_stat_lynx_spirit_bound == 0; hw_stat_shaman_taught == 0): a spirit is bound and the Lynx Spirit is not, so its one answer unlocks hw_bp_spirit_lynx_calling through BlueprintsFullUnlock (the calling's own StatValues gate on its bound latch is what the unlock skips) and sets the taught marker, so the shaman teaches ONE calling in a run. The four lines together cover every mix of the Lynx, Goat and Blood Spirits bound short of all three; the scene lists them in order before the greeting, and DialogScene.GetStartingLine takes the first whose StartingConditions hold. NextStep 2 = DialogStep.ExitDialog. Pattern copied from Community_Mod_Chest/ScriptableObject/DialogLine/CMC_ApothecaryTalk_HerbQuestThanks.json. Which calling each mix is taught is a TUNABLE PLACEHOLDER.

Line.DefaultText: You carry a spirit already, I can feel it on you. Good. Then you will understand this one. Sit a while and I will teach you the calling of the Lynx Spirit, the quiet hunter of the rocks.
